thread:
Priya: fyi customer ACME hit a deprovisioning incident — all admins removed after an Okta group rename. SCIM delta shows a `replace members` patch. Has anyone seen externalId/name churn causing role mappings to drop?

Jonathan: can you paste the raw SCIM payload you received?

Priya: here's the anonymized patch from Okta: 
```json
{
  "schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations":[
    {"op":"replace","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-123","display":"alice@example.com"}]}
  ]
}
```

Priya: but our audit shows we treated that as remove+add and the user lost the `redwood_admins` role for ~2min.

Maya: looks like Okta renaming the group changed the group's externalId from `okta-456` -> `okta-456:alias` during the operation. Our mapping precedence currently requires exact externalId match, so transient mismatch unmaps.

Jonathan: what token scope was the connector using? any 403s?

Priya: connector had `scim:write` but audit captured a `403 SCIM patch denied: insufficient scope` on the initial attempt, then retries triggered a full replace. Log snippet: `2024-06-21T14:02:03Z ERROR scim-handler patch 403 insufficient_scope`.

Priya: because the first patch failed, Okta retried and the next patch came through as a `replace` which our handler interprets as remove-all then add, so roles briefly dropped.

ops-bot: incident CS-3123 created for ACME deprovisioning spike :warning:

Maya: immediate workaround: re-add role from Console or trigger a resync of the group membership. Steps I gave CS: 
1) Console -> Teams -> Groups -> search `gw-9876` (ACME group id)
2) Click 'Resync members' or call admin API: `POST /admin/scim/groups/gw-9876/resync`
3) If urgent: `PATCH /orgs/acme/users/user-123/roles` body `{"add":["redwood_admins"]}`

Priya: customer rep re-added the role via console, confirmed admin access restored.

Jonathan: longer-term fixes proposed: 
- Treat `replace members` as delta-preserving (don't remove roles until add confirmed)
- Make group->role mapping tolerant of externalId edits: fallback to stable identifiers (group id or hashed displayName) when externalId flips
- Surface externalId changes in the SCIM audit logs for CS visibility
Filed INF-789 to track.

Maya: also: ensure connector token scopes are validated and we emit clearer errors (403 -> actionable hint).

Priya: logging ask: add `okta_change=true` flag when we detect externalId rename so CS can filter the audit.

Maya: pinging @eng-infra and @eng-platform for priority. :mag:

Priya: thanks all :heart:
